text.en: What does not kill me makes me stronger.
text.ko: 나를 죽이지 못하는 것은 나를 더 강하게 만든다.
text.zh-cn: 凡杀不死我的，必使我更强大。
text.fr: Ce qui ne me tue pas me rend plus fort.

caption.en:
notes from the days I lasted

en: I said it would kill me.
ko: 다음 날 아침, 나는 밥을 먹었다.

moral.en: The place that cracked is the thickest once it heals.
moral.ko: 금이 간 자리는 붙어도, 그 자리가 가장 두껍다.

characters: a man in his 30s, short black hair, plain grey shirt, tired posture

cta.en: Follow @shinsegi.en — a new story every day

scenes.image_prompt: empty mountain ridge at first light, low fog, long shot

narration.en: What does not kill me makes me stronger. — Friedrich Nietzsche.
narration.ko: 나를 죽이지 못하는 것은 나를 더 강하게 만든다. — 프리드리히 니체.
narration.fr: Ce qui ne me tue pas me rend plus fort.

scenes.image_prompt: dim kitchen at night, single chair at a table, person sitting, seen from behind, wide shot

narration.en: I said it would kill me. Next morning, I ate breakfast
narration.ko: 죽을 것 같다고 말했다. 다음 날 아침, 나는 밥을 먹었다
narration.zh-cn: 我说过这事会要我的命。第二天早上，我吃了饭。
narration.fr: J'ai dit que ça allait me tuer. Le lendemain matin, j'ai mangé.

scenes.image_prompt: narrow alley at dawn, wet pavement, small figure walking away, long shot

narration.en: My feet were heavy leaving the alley.
narration.zh-cn: 走出巷子的时候，脚很沉。
narration.fr: En sortant de la ruelle, mes jambes étaient lourdes.

scenes.image_prompt: cluttered desk by a window, morning light, stacked papers, person sitting, seen from behind

narration.en: I sat at the desk. I wrote nothing.
narration.ko: 책상 앞에 앉았다. 한 줄도 못 썼다.
narration.zh-cn: 我坐在桌前。一行也没写。
narration.fr: Je me suis assis au bureau. Je n'ai rien écrit.

scenes.image_prompt: concrete stairwell, hard light from a high window, small figure sitting on steps, long shot

narration.en: I sat on the stairs. My legs still shook.
narration.zh-cn: 我坐在楼梯上。腿还在抖。
narration.fr: Je me suis assis dans l'escalier. Les jambes tremblaient.

scenes.image_prompt: bus stop by an empty road at dusk, glass shelter, distant figure standing, wide shot

narration.en: I missed the bus. I just stood and waited.
narration.zh-cn: 错过了公交。我就站着等。
narration.fr: J'ai raté le bus. J'ai attendu, debout.

scenes.image_prompt: small kitchen at night, kettle on a lit stove, person standing, seen from behind, wide shot

narration.en: I boiled water in the kitchen. Next day I went out again.
narration.ko: 부엌에서 물을 끓였다. 다음 날 또 나갔다.
narration.zh-cn: 我在厨房烧水。第二天又出门了。
narration.fr: J'ai fait bouillir de l'eau. Le lendemain, je suis ressorti.

scenes.image_prompt: open desk drawer full of receipts, dim room, small figure nearby, seen from behind

narration.en: Receipts piled up in a drawer. Each one a day I lasted.
narration.ko: 서랍에 영수증이 쌓였다. 버틴 날의 것들.
narration.zh-cn: 抽屉里的收据越堆越多。每张都是一天。
narration.fr: Les tickets s'entassaient dans le tiroir. Un par jour où j'ai tenu.

scenes.image_prompt: quiet room at night, single lamp on a desk, person at the drawer, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: That drawer is still there. One more went in yesterday.
narration.ko: 그 서랍은 아직 있다. 어제도 한 장 늘었다.
narration.zh-cn: 那个抽屉还在。昨天又多了一张。
narration.fr: Ce tiroir est toujours là. Hier, un ticket de plus.

scenes.image_prompt: window at night, rain on the glass, distant figure by the sill, long shot

narration.en: The place that cracked is the thickest once it heals.
narration.ko: 금이 간 자리는 붙어도, 그 자리가 가장 두껍다.
narration.zh-cn: 裂过的地方，长好以后最厚。
narration.fr: L'endroit qui a craqué devient le plus épais.
